body:
This looks like the same underlying issue already reported in #14598 (and previously in #13069, #11983, #12320 — all closed but apparently recurring), so I'd suggest `duplicate` with #14598 as the active tracking issue rather than opening parallel investigation here.

For context on the likely cause: `gh pr edit` currently detects Projects (classic) support by checking the GraphQL host type via `ProjectsV1()`, and only strips the `projectCards` field from the query when the detector reports it unsupported — see [pkg/cmd/pr/shared/finder.go#L234-L246](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/31d9601e292365301cb5d66c73b4e12334895be1/pkg/cmd/pr/shared/finder.go#L234-L246). The detector's [`ProjectsV1()`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/31d9601e292365301cb5d66c73b4e12334895be1/internal/featuredetection/feature_detection.go#L335-L347) implementation treats any non-Enterprise host as `ProjectsV1Unsupported` and skips `projectCards` only for Enterprise hosts below a version cutoff — it does not account for individual github.com repositories that still have a classic project attached despite the general GitHub.com-wide sunset. So for github.com repos with a lingering classic project, `projectCards` is still requested and GitHub's GraphQL API now errors on that field rather than returning data, causing the whole `pr edit` to fail. This is a plausible root cause but should be confirmed against an actual reproduction before engineering work begins.

Given the recurring and apparently still-unresolved nature of this across multiple closed issues, I'd suggest `bug` and `priority-2` in addition to `duplicate` (no workaround via `gh` itself, though the REST PATCH workaround mentioned in the report does work).
